name: 🌡️ [UPDATE!] 1 Click = 1 Heat! 🔥
desc:
Dear players,

Update 1.3 for 1 Click = 1 Heat.

This update introduces major improvements and new content designed to enhance progression, balance, and overall performance.

🎲 Random Events
 Automatic events every 10 minutes.

🔥 Hell Heat
 New event with 2x Heat boost.

♻️ Rebirth 51–60
 Progression cap expanded.

🐞 Fixes & Optimization
 Performance improvements and bug fixes.
 Thank you for your continued support.

 — Studio Unluck.
